newsitem.title: USA: Progressive ends talks on Danielson stake.
newsitem.headline: Progressive ends talks on Danielson stake.

text.p: Progressive Corp ended negotiations over acquiring shares of Danielson Holding Corp, the companies said on Monday.

Under a proposed transaction, the property and casualty insurance company would have acquired about 11 million newly issued shares of Danielson common stock for a consideration having a value of $6.60 per share. The stake would have represented about 42 percent of Danielson's common stock.

Danielson said it would reopen discussions with other parties. Such discussions had been suspended pending the outcome of the negotiations with Progressive. It also said it would explore other opportunities.

Danielson, a financial service company involved in insurance and investment management, said it could offer "no assurance that any such discussions or exploration will lead to an agreement regarding a transaction or that any agreement reached will ultimately be consummated."
